data.name: AdminMaintenanceAutoStartNote
data.value: A softphone that did not come back after a night-time restart misses the first calls of the shift. Startup is also shown in Cinnamon Startup Applications.

data.name: AdminAccountPasswordNote
data.value: The password is encrypted with a key kept in this user's profile and readable only by them: a settings file carried to another machine does not give it up.

data.name: AppearanceLanguageNote
data.value: “System” follows the session: Russian when the session language is Russian, English in all other cases.

data.name: AdminGuardSyntheticNote
data.value: The X server marks clicks made by software through XTest with its own device, and only an input driver can forge that mark. By default it is still only written to the report.

data.name: PanelWaylandNotice
data.value: Wayland session is not supported: answer protection is weaker. Sign in to an X11 session
